# CaliforniaMailer

CaliforniaMailer offers 9 x 12 co-op postcard advertising inquiries for Monterey County and California businesses. Businesses share a postcard and its printing and mailing costs.

## Services
- Shared co-op postcard advertising
- Design and print support
- Custom direct-mail campaign inquiries

## How to inquire
Visit https://californiamailer.com/quote with your business category, target area, offer, and artwork needs. Placement availability, ad size, quantity, costs, campaign funding requirements, and schedule are confirmed in writing. Website samples are concept layouts with sample ads, not participating advertisers or live inventory.

## Current website scope
The website accepts quote requests. It does not take payment, place print orders, reserve ad spaces, or guarantee delivery dates or advertising results. Checkout remains disabled.
